disposition.scope: Bounded checkpoint-navigation refinement and attributable regressions only. No release, provider, performance, or accessibility certification.

contractAssessment.result: met within the supplied feature evidence
contractAssessment.navigation: checkpoint.list searches all records before paging, including saved run text beyond truncated labels and revision strings, using NFKC normalization and lowercasing. All/Flagged/Safety filters, totals, 100-item paging, Newest, timestamp/ID ordering, and stale-offset clamp are implemented. Targeted desktop tests cover full-message tails, normalized accented text, filters, repeatable ordering, and stale offsets.
contractAssessment.selectionResilience: Message links clear search/filter state and request the exact ID. Pending search blocks selection actions and restore; the most recent queued link or filter/search intent controls the next load. Unflagging in Flagged clears the removed selection. Unavailable checkpoints leave no restore target; explicit Refresh recovers browsing. Native tests exercise these selection and recovery paths. The pending debounce guard is source-assessed rather than independently exercised in this review.
contractAssessment.localGitMeaning: Visible copy distinguishes local checkpoints from repository commits and states branch/staging preservation. Before message, After reply, and Safety copy labels, full detail date, snapshot count, local revision, Copy Revision, and workspace-specific title are present.
contractAssessment.reviewedRestore: Both restore captures retain changed-file review, exclusions, safety checkpoint language, original-conversation preservation, and Restore & Continue into a new conversation. Supplied flow verification records actual local restore. Existing backend recovery guarantees were not re-certified.

materialFindings.assessment: No material defect or attributable visual regression found in the seven required captures and targeted implementation.

craftPlatformAssessment.assessment: Preserves the incumbent AppKit identity: system type and semantic appearance, native search and segmented controls, native table selection, SF Symbols, selectable detail, and a protected restore sheet. Search and filters lead the browsing hierarchy; pagination, metadata, and review actions remain readable and reachable. Light compact and dark wide states show no clipped checkpoint controls or restore decisions. macOS conventions govern sizing and window behavior; iOS touch sizing and display-type prescriptions were not transplanted.
craftPlatformAssessment.compactGeometry: Compact workspace frames are 720 x 500 points. The modeless checkpoint panel may extend beyond its parent and remains fully represented in native window-group captures. Exterior transparency and parent edges are not application clipping. Exact 720 x 480 acceptance and the panel minimum-size extreme are not established.
craftPlatformAssessment.webDetector: Not applicable to the native AppKit surface; none ran.

evidenceLimitations.captureValidity: All seven raw native window-group captures accepted; corresponding JSON agrees with displayed count, filter, selection, restore availability, and appearance. Wide workspace frames are 1312 x 731 points; compact frames are 720 x 500 points.
evidenceLimitations.suppliedVerification: native-tests.log reports 61 passing tests; desktop-tests.log reports 69 passing tests. Provenance reports TypeScript, changed-file lint, native UI flow, and packaged runtime passing. verification.json records restore into a new conversation. packaged-runtime.json establishes bundled capability negotiation and empty checkpoint history, not a full populated-history navigation exercise.
evidenceLimitations.provenanceValidation: Independently matched all four supplied SHA-256 hashes: native checkpoint source, desktop worker source, built native executable, and bundled runtime dist/index.js.
evidenceLimitations.execution: Reviewer read screenshots, diagnostics, source, and supplied logs. Did not launch the app, rerun tests, rebuild, or execute a provider. Only this review.json was written.
